race.description: Speeding Spur Standing @ Woodlands Stud Trotters Standing Start Hcp
race.comment: CHIEF RUNNINGCLOUD (8) was good when runner-up here two back then started favourite last week but manners let him down. Switches to a standing start and cops a 40m handicap but came from this mark to win here last month. Worth another chance. DOLLYS LAW (4) appreciated the switch to a standing start when she took control and kept finding to score by 1.3m at this circuit and distance four weeks ago. Kept fresh since and goes back 10m in the handicap but could go back-to-back. LOTUS LOUISE (9) is better than his recent form may suggest. He could find his best today. BERTINELLI (5) is in the mix after turning in a better effort last start to finish second here last week.
